name: UT Workday
description: Unit tests of every Workday command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.text: Unit tests of every Workday command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

args.message: Unit test agent UT Workday started

args.title: 1. ooa.workday/authenticate - sign in and keep a session

args.text: Authenticate swaps the API client's refresh token for an access token and keeps host, tenant and token as the Workday session, so the next steps need no address or sign-in. Checks the token's lifetime.

children.description: Sign in to the stand-in tenant

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.message: the access token: expected notEmpty , got ${wd_token}

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.value: ${ut_report}PASS  ooa.workday/authenticate: sign in and keep a session

children.description: Add a PASS line to the report
Run the command and check what it gave back

args.value: ${ut_report}FAIL  ooa.workday/authenticate: sign in and keep a session: ${ut_err}

children.description: Add a FAIL line with the reason

steps.description: 1. ooa.workday/authenticate - sign in and keep a session
